---
name: validate-frontend
description: Install, lint, typecheck, test and build the website frontend and check its nginx/Docker deployment pieces. Use before reporting any change as done.
---

# Validate vempain-website-frontend

- Checked-in Yarn 4; `@vempain/*` packages need `VEMPAIN_ACTION_TOKEN` for `yarn install --immutable`.
- Run after behaviour, routing, API, authentication or deployment changes:
  ```bash
  yarn lint
  yarn typecheck
  yarn test
  yarn build:production
  ```
- `src/buildInfo.json` is generated by `generateBuildInfo.js`; do not commit its changes, nor `dist/`, `coverage/`, `node_modules/` or local
  `.env` files (`.env.example` is the template, `VITE_API_BASE_URL`).
- Deployment: `nginx.conf.template` is rendered at container start with `NGINX_ENVSUBST_FILTER=^VEMPAIN_` (`VEMPAIN_BACKEND_ADDRESS` upstream,
  crawler proxy for Open Graph, `/api`, `/file`, `/health` to the backend); keep nginx's own `$variables` untouched and test template
  changes with a container build. The reverse proxy contract is mirrored in `vempain-cluster/website/`.
- Security relevant changes go to `security/OWASP-2025-audit-report.md`; CI is `frontend-spa.yaml` of `vempain-workflows`.
